newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai soybean ends up on individual buying.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai soybean ends up on individual buying.

text.p: Shanghai soybean futures ended up on Monday due to purchases by individual investors encouraged by good-looking technical charts, traders said.

The key November 1996 contract ended at an intra-day high of 3,350 yuan ($403) per tonne, up 25 yuan. It opened at a low of 3,308. January rose nine to 3,237 yuan, March 16 to 3,250 and May 40 to 3,480.
Combined volume fell to 4,300 tonnes from 40,000.
Traders said some individual investors pushed prices up after consolidation over the past few days.
"Speculative buying by individual investors was responsible for today's rises," one trader said.
"Technical charts have supported the market since the November contract breached the 3,300-yuan level," he added.
Traders expect soybean to continue its stable upward growth in the next few days.
